description: Improve code quality, performance, type safety, and maintainability across the codebase
steps: PERF 1 - Editor.tsx draw() function: The dot grid draws thousands of individual arcs per frame. Replace with a single pattern-based approach or limit dots to viewport. Also the draw function is recreated every render via useCallback with many deps - memoize better or use requestAnimationFrame pattern.
PERF 2 - Editor.tsx handleMouseMove: Every mouse move during selection triggers getElementsInSelection which iterates all elements. Use spatial indexing or at minimum early-exit for empty selections.

TYPE SAFETY 1 - canvasStore.ts addElement uses Omit<CanvasElement, 'id' | 'seed'> but the Editor passes extra properties like 'text', 'fontSize', 'points' which only exist on certain element types. Create discriminated union types for CanvasElement creation.
TYPE SAFETY 2 - The canvasStore uses 'any' type for roughjs options and dbUpdates in useScenes. Replace with proper types.
CODE QUALITY 1 - Editor.tsx is 2500+ lines. Extract reusable logic into custom hooks: useCanvasDrawing, useCanvasInteraction, useKeyboardShortcuts, useExport. Keep the component focused on rendering.
CODE QUALITY 2 - Dashboard.tsx has inline event handler functions that create new closures on every render. Extract stable handler references with useCallback for performance.
CODE QUALITY 3 - Add proper aria-labels and roles to interactive elements: toolbar buttons, color pickers, scene cards for accessibility.
CODE QUALITY 4 - The useScenes and useFolders hooks duplicate the same error handling pattern. Extract a shared useSupabaseQuery pattern or utility.
acceptance_criteria: Editor component is split into smaller, more maintainable pieces
No 'any' types remain in core logic
Canvas drawing performance is improved (fewer draw calls for grid)
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and confirm no type errors
Run npx vitest run and confirm all tests pass
